desc: 薄椭圆灯头配柔韧长颈，圆盘滑触操控，白昼书房读写光
leaf: 薄椭圆灯头滑触圆盘长颈读写台灯
name: 白昼书房滑触长颈读写台灯款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用合规净白主图钉住椭圆灯头、长颈与圆盘的形体基准。
一秒法则：在浅雾蓝信息板上把核心读写光利益一次讲完，确立整套色板与字体。
shots.textZone: upper-left third carries the headline block with two chip labels stacked under it

shots.intent: 把普通桌面照明的三类真实光害摆在同一机位下，让买家在自己的书桌上对号入座。
shots.textZone: headline centred in the top band, one chip label centred under each card

shots.intent: 同机位对照两种灯头俯角，说明长颈定形后光线始终压在作业面上而不是射向眼睛。
shots.textZone: headline centred above the two panels, one chip label centred under each panel

shots.intent: 用灯头收边与出光面质感的微距证明薄身做工与均匀出光，而不是靠参数宣称。
俯拍圆盘底座的滑触控制区，把操作方式讲成一眼可懂的图形语言。
shots.textZone: headline across the top band, one label at each of two chip positions

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实白天书桌，用一台合上的笔记本锚定尺度并让买家代入。
把可选光型做成三段并列选段，让买家按用途挑而不是按参数挑。
shots.textZone: headline centred at the top, three mode labels stacked in the left column beside their strips

shots.intent: 用做工要点加一栏留空信息位收掉疑虑，替代原图的证照与参数堆砌。
shots.textZone: headline at the top left, product on the lower left, four-row chip list filling the right column with empty value slots

shots.intent: 回到浅雾蓝主色收口，用一条行动指令完成整套转化闭环。
shots.textZone: headline band across the upper third, rounded action button centred under the product, two chip labels along the bottom edge

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF field for the packshot, the structure screen and the comparison pair; pale #EAF2FA panels for every infographic; the single lifestyle screen uses a bright daytime study corner with a #EAF2FA wall and a matte #F4F7FA lacquer desk, no dark room and no night window

style.iconSystem: small rounded-square outline chips, single 2px stroke in #7CA9CC on a #FFFFFF chip, one centred filled dot inside each chip, one chip per claim; explicitly no bracket rules, no top-and-bottom hairline rules, no crosshair marks, no leaf or petal marks, no 3D icons and no illustration shading

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright daytime study-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless #FFFFFF field, pale #EAF2FA infographic panels, #2A3540 type, one #7CA9CC accent and one #FFFDF8 light-pool tone; cool temperature on an even diffuse daylight balance at 5700K with no night-time practical glow; modern geometric sans-serif only, headline 28-40pt, label 12-16pt, one wide-tracked small-caps English kicker, copy inside chips not on hairline rules; broad diffuse key from camera-left, low contrast, soft open contact shadows, thin rim separation on the head edge, identical light direction on matched panels; matte #F4F7FA lacquer desk and pale panels, no gloss and no wood grain; icon language is small rounded-square outline chips in #7CA9CC with one centred filled dot, no bracket rules, no crosshairs, no leaf marks; the slim ellipse head, the long supple neck and the flat disc base keep identical silhouette, proportion, joint geometry and scale in every panel, the emitting face always angled toward the work plane and away from the viewer, straight lines stay straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented specification figures, no certification artwork.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no extra accent colors
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten lettering
no random backgrounds and no gradient washes

no certification mark, framed document, seal, laboratory report, authorisation artwork, QR code, store badge or membership corner tag
no bracket rules, no crosshair marks and no leaf marks in the icon system; chips stay rounded-square outlines with one centred dot

no direct view into the lit emitting face, no glow leaking through the housing, no lamp clipped onto a flammable surface, no cable running under a chair leg, no dismantled, opened or half-assembled housing
no warped neck or joint geometry, no kinked curve, no bent straight edges
no inconsistent light direction between matched comparison panels
style.presentationRules: the slim ellipse head, the long supple neck and the flat disc base with its small control field keep the same silhouette, proportion, joint geometry, finish and scale in every panel; the product is always grounded by a visible contact shadow and never floats; the emitting face is always tilted toward the work plane and turned away from the camera so the lit surface is never pointed at the viewer; the neck curve never kinks; straight edges on desk lines, rails and panel borders stay optically straight; only angle, crop and panel purpose change
style.surfaceSystem: matte #F4F7FA lacquer desk and matte #FFFFFF or #EAF2FA panels, soft #DCE6F0 shadow side, no glossy floor, no mirror reflection, no wood grain
